title: Sections of a tensor relation cokernel
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $B,C$ sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_Y$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], $\varphi:B\to C$ an algebra morphism, and $P$ a sheaf of $B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $P_0,B_0,C_0$ for the underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-modules, $S=C_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}P_0$ and $F=B_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}S$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $\delta:F\to S$ be an $\mathcal O_Y$-module morphism and $W$ any open. Suppose its section formula is $\delta_W(b\otimes\tau(c,p))=\tau(c,bp)-\tau(\varphi_W(b)c,p)$ for all $b,c,p$, that both canonical section tensor maps $C(W)\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y(W)}P(W)\to S(W)$ and $B(W)\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y(W)}S(W)\to F(W)$ are bijective, and that the cokernel projection $q_W:S(W)\to\operatorname{coker}(\delta)(W)$ is surjective with $\ker(q_W)=\operatorname{range}(\delta_W)$. Then there exists an additive equivalence $\lambda:C(W)\otimes_{B(W)}P(W)\simeq\operatorname{coker}(\delta)(W)$ such that $\lambda(c\otimes p)=q_W(\tau(c,p))$ for all $c,p$. No affineness or quasi-coherence assumption is imposed beyond these explicit section hypotheses.

proof.text: Put R=O_Y(W). The section tensor bijections identify S(W) with C(W) tensor_R P(W), and F(W) with B(W) tensor_R S(W). Pure tensors generate these modules additively. The relation formula identifies range δ_W, pulled back to C(W) tensor_R P(W), with the R-submodule N spanned by c tensor bp - φ(b)c tensor p.

proof.text: The balancing projection π:C(W) tensor_R P(W) -> C(W) tensor_B(W) P(W) is surjective on pure tensors and kills N. The map (c,p) to the class of c tensor p in the quotient by N is additive in both variables and B(W)-balanced. It therefore induces an inverse to the map from that quotient induced by π; both inverse identities follow on pure tensors and extend by additivity.

proof.text: By the assumed surjectivity and kernel equality, q_W identifies its target with S(W)/range δ_W. Transporting along the section tensor bijection identifies this quotient with (C(W) tensor_R P(W))/N. Compose with the preceding balanced tensor quotient equivalence. The resulting additive equivalence has the required pure tensor formula.

theorem tensor_relation_section_quotient (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right))
    (δ : tensorObj B.toModule
      (tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)) ⟶
      tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P))
    (W : Y.Opens)
    (hrel : ∀ (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W)) (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W))
        (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
      δ.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
        (tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
          (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) c p)) =
        tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
          (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) c (b • p) -
        tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
          (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)
            (φ.right.hom.app (op W) b * c) p)
    (hS : Function.Bijective (tensorSectionsMap C.toModule
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) W))
    (hF : Function.Bijective (tensorSectionsMap B.toModule
      (tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)) W))
    (hq : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π δ).app W))
    (hk : LinearMap.ker ((cokernel.π δ).val.app (op W)).hom =
      LinearMap.range (δ.val.app (op W)).hom) :
    ∃ l : (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} φ.right P).obj (op W) ≃+
        Γ(cokernel δ, W),
      ∀ (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        l (c ⊗ₜ[B.right.obj.obj (op W), (φ.right.hom.app (op W)).hom] p) =
          (cokernel.π δ).app W (tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
            (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) c p)
